title: Wondering if there are French New Wave experts on this sub who could tell what's the article being discussed on this video?

commenti.body: On doing some googling, it seems like the article is actually called Little Themes (Les Petits Sujets). It was in Issue 100 from October 1959 and appears to be translated in [this book](https://archive.org/details/newwavecriticall0000grah/mode/2up). Just use the borrow function on internet archive and you should be able to find it.
Nice find.  I'm not op, but it was an interesting read.  Only took a couple of minutes.
Idk, but is it after the release of Chabrol's Le Beau Serge (his first film)? It was criticised for not tackling big themes by left wing writers and Chabrol said no theme is big or small...
thank you so much, you are my hero!

Adrian Martin has a website, you can go on his website and get in touch with him and potentially ask your question. And subscribe to read more content. He makes pretty awesome video essays too with his wife.
